findings.title: Semantic image_case and image regions crop screenshot evidence without a contain control
findings.root_cause: PhotoSchema limits refs to path/url/alt; itsImageColumn and regionImage rebuild refs without Fit. Default cover therefore applies to screenshots as well as photos. The raw shape-grid contract supports contain but the semantic workflow does not expose it.
observed: p-style slide09 srcRect crops 11.523% top and 11.523% bottom of a 1600x1000 dashboard: visible source interval y=115.23..884.77; dashboard banner and bottom action line disappear.
Abstract image_case crops 10.436% each end; replacing it with a 65% image region increases crop to18.440% each end. More width cannot preserve full evidence without aspect-aware sizing/contain.
Full-res source and output were inspected; table evidence is retained at center, but the whole screenshot is not preserved.
acceptance_criteria: Expose image.fit in image_case and image-region contracts; preserve contain through compilation and expansion.
With contain selected, all dashboard bounds render on p-style and a second distinct template, while photo cover remains selectable.
Add source-bound screenshot regression, not only no-error generation.

findings.title: Process composition overrides change the explanation but still compile the default refused pattern
findings.root_cause: Compile passes Visual.Pattern and Visual.Layout in slides.Input, but CompileProcess switches on ProcessPattern(in.Body) rather than the selected in.Pattern/in.Layout. Its branches recreate a numbered-step-strip. The IR explanation reports the requested override, so discovery and rendering disagree.
observed: Modern spec-adapted2 process slide has layout:content; explanation_summary reports layout content and promises native bullets, but generation error names layout Blank + Title, numbered-step-strip, Capture 9.84pt.
Modern spec-adapted3 requests pattern:process-flow; explanation reports process-flow but refusal still names numbered-step-strip and /slides/7/rendered_shapes/201/paragraphs/0.
The 4 labels are Capture/Assign/Resolve/Close; all detailed steps remain authored. No content was deleted to make this succeed.
acceptance_criteria: Process pattern overrides select the requested supported compiler, with descriptions preserved.
layout:content actually emits a native source-complete bullet slide and no pattern; explanation and actual raw/rendered output agree.
Regression includes a payload that fails default strip on Modern, then succeeds with the advertised alternative; assert all four descriptions remain.

findings.title: Abstract section dividers still break ordinary all-caps words mid-word without a finding
findings.root_cause: The existing longest-word fit guard uses estimated/font-metric capacity plus a3% margin, yet the rendered uppercase word still exceeds the actual divider width. The exact glyph/style cause is not isolated; this is an observed rendered regression against the prior fix, not an asserted font-cache cause.
observed: Source title Diagnose the bottleneck and choose the model (44chars) renders BOTTLENEC / K AND; Prove the model before committing to scale renders COMMITTIN / G TO SCALE.
Abstract adapted deck validation permits these titles and deterministic_ready is true.
Generated first title box is x6991350 y487018, width4179570 height3377354 EMU; its explicit size is5149hpt, noAutofit. Full-res PNG shows the broken words.
Shorter section rewrites resolve it in spec-adapted2, showing authoring workaround; no automated remediation identified the original defects.
acceptance_criteria: Both source titles render with complete words on Abstract at >=28pt, or return an actionable divider-specific refusal before ready.
Use actual all-caps inherited font, spacing, margins and resolved geometry when measuring longest-word capacity.
Pixel regression checks BOTTLENECK and COMMITTING line boundaries; do not merely assert explicit font size above28pt.

findings.title: Fit repair targets short labels and returns larger-than-current character budgets for shared height failures
findings.root_cause: worstReadability identifies the worst paragraph and attaches paragraph_text. retargetCellReadabilityFix then adds maxChars for the entire grid cell. Semantic mapping identifies the individual authored field using paragraph_text, while retaining the cell-wide max_chars. Thus the patch edits only an eyebrow/label with a budget measured for the shared cell. Joint height constraints are hidden from that edit.
observed: Modern strip label Capture (7chars) remains9.84pt after long labels become one word; all4label findings ask shorten_text. The original label max_chars budget is larger than current label, so the advertised limit gives no usable reduction.

Midnight image_case eyebrow PILOT DESIGN (12chars, under documented30) maps to a12pt paragraph rendering10.8pt. Primary apply_patch asks to rewrite that eyebrow to at most532characters, strategy split. That budget is the shared cell budget rather than an eyebrow-specific safe limit.
Removing the optional eyebrow and retaining narrative/bullets/metrics gets past this refusal; increasing or rewriting the eyebrow alone is not a sensible repair.
These are guidance defects independent of whether the source can fit: a valid refusal may remain, but its primary suggested edit must address the constrained region.
acceptance_criteria: For height-limited grouped cells, provide fewer rows/shorter detail/more vertical area/native alternative as the primary repair, with exact authored paths.
A max_chars repair budget must apply to the field it patches and meaningfully reduce the failing extent; never suggest a532char eyebrow for a12char source.
Re-run the stated primary patch on the source while preserving content; either readability improves or clearly label the guidance as a composition-level manual repair.
